rules.title: Rules
rules.quote: Don't be toxic, be like a cookie — sweet and warm :3
rules.rule1: 1. Deliberate use of profanity or insults directed at other chat members.
rules.rule2detail: More than three identical messages in a row, or links to external sites unrelated to the chat's topics.
rules.rule3: 3. Systematic or deliberate communication in Russian.
rules.rule3detail1: Our community is Ukrainian-speaking. We strive to support, spread and grow Ukrainian content!
rules.rule3detail2: We understand that for some it may be difficult to switch to Ukrainian immediately. We encourage you not to be afraid, not to be ashamed of mistakes, but to practice and gradually integrate into our community.
rules.rule4: 4. Commercial advertising without prior approval from the administration is prohibited.
rules.rule4detail1: Within our community, without administration approval, you are welcome to advertise your personal projects or non-commercial channels.
rules.rule4detail2: If you are a commercial project, recruiting agency, company, etc., please contact the administration regarding advertising via <link>> Shokolapka <</link>.
rules.punishment1: After two warnings, the administration has the right to mute or ban a member.
rules.punishment2: The administration also reserves the right to ban a member if they threaten the cozy atmosphere of the chat.
rules.appeal: If you disagree with an administration decision, you can appeal it via <link>> Shokolapka <</link>.

about.title: Who are we? What are we?
about.p1: Our community mainly revolves around IT (programming, computers, electronics), but our conversations are by no means limited to just that ;)
about.p2: At the heart of our community is the development of talents and beloved hobbies.
about.p3: Here you can discuss your hobbies and interests, meet and make friends, organize to create projects, ask questions and find solutions.
about.p4: I believe this community will become a wonderful place where people can share their passions, help each other, unite to build projects together, and simply enjoy great conversations.
